hints.title: Distinct Frequency Sorting
hints.text: Count frequencies of every distinct character in the string.

hints.title: Greedy Character Removal
hints.text: To minimize deleted characters, eliminate characters with the lowest total counts first.

hints.title: Prefix Sum of Frequencies
hints.text: Sort the frequency list ascendingly and sum the first len - k elements.

complexity.notes: Frequency sorting over at most 26 characters runs in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all subsets of characters to drop is combinatorially wasteful.
